pub-cawn.figureCaption: Matched-set structure, from the CAWN presentation slides.

pub-science.figureCaption: Cycles of idea creation and exhaustion following major AI breakthroughs.
pub-science.figureAlt: Six panels show the idea life cycle, new and dead idea shares, AlexNet and Transformer citation patterns, successive active-idea cycles, and simulated effects of reciprocal reviewing.

pub-qegf.figureCaption: QEGF combines geometric multimodal fusion with energy-based uncertainty modeling.
pub-qegf.figureAlt: QEGF architecture showing audio, text and video encoding, quantum-inspired geometric fusion, a task-adaptive transformer, energy-based uncertainty modeling, and uncertainty-guided prediction.

pub-pooling.figureCaption: Shared hierarchical backbone used in the graph-pooling benchmark.
pub-pooling.figureAlt: Graph-pooling benchmark backbone: message passing transforms the input graph, pooling reduces it, and readout produces a graph-level feature for supervised prediction.

pub-pvi-dpo.figureCaption: Background-restoration comparisons against FloED and VideoPainter.
pub-pvi-dpo.figureAlt: Two rows of video-inpainting comparisons show a bus and a mountain scene, with masked inputs, baseline reconstructions, and PVI-DPO results; boxes mark boundaries and structural details.

pub-heart.figureCaption: HEART uses complementary audio–visual routes to control adaptation strength.
pub-heart.figureAlt: HEART pipeline: audio and visual inputs provide an anchor pseudo-label; complementary half-routes assess support; batch coverage and contrast set a gate that weights adaptation and permits a Self-Anchor fallback.
